notes.title: Voodolls Key Features and Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Voodoo Enthusiasts!
[/b]
Ready to embark on a mystical journey like no other? Look no further than Voodolls, the captivating cooperative 3D Action Tower Defense game that beckons you to become a voodoo doll and take on demon armies in breathtaking spherical worlds.

 Immerse yourself in the heart of the underworld as you join four damned souls, granted a shot at redemption. Transformed into voodoo dolls, your mission is crystal clear: safeguard the enigmatic Puppet Master, Agwe Saint-Fleur, on a perilous odyssey to the very core of the World of Seasons. Yet, escaping Hell's clutches was never meant to be straightforward...

[b]Voodolls Key Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Unite action, exploration, and strategic tower defense for an unparalleled gameplay experience.
[*] Embark on an adventure across stylized round planets, each representing a different season.
[*] Assemble a formidable team of four distinctive Voodolls, each boasting unique abilities, weapons, and tactical prowess.
[*] Seize the chance for solo escapades or team up in online co-op with up to four players, safeguarding the Puppet Master in a gripping campaign.
[*] Immerse yourself in a story-driven campaign that unravels the mysteries surrounding the puppet master and his dolls.
[*] Choose from three camera angles – immerse yourself in the fray from first-person, observe the action in third-person, or strategize from above with the tactical camera.
[*] Delve into extensive replayability, brimming with diverse enemy types and ingenious traps to defend your Puppet Master against the relentless hordes of Hell.
[/list]

For a limited time, seize the opportunity to join the ranks of Voodolls at an enticing 35% off on Steam! Unleash your inner voodoo warrior and harness the power of synergy between action, strategy, and tower defense. Embrace the unknown, triumph over the sinister forces of Hell, and let the adventure of a lifetime begin!

[h3]Grab Voodolls now on Steam![/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Available
notes.content:
Hello Voodolls community,

We're excited to announce the release of a new patch for our cooperative Action Tower Defense game, Voodolls! This update brings a variety of enhancements and bug fixes that will further enhance your gaming experience. Read on to discover the key changes included in this patch:

[list]
[*] The number of souls a Client receives after selling a Trap no longer depends on a Host.
[*] Weaker versions of 'Aeshma' will no longer randomly stand idle when players use the 'Deceptive Innocence' ability.
[*] Fonts for Bindings settings have been unified for a more consistent visual experience.
[*] The 'Refund' option will no longer be displayed if a player does not point at a 'Trap'.
[*] The wooden box no longer floats in the air after a player breaks the box placed below it.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We appreciate your dedication to the game and hope that this patch enriches your Voodolls experience.

The Voodolls Development Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Live
notes.content:
Greetings Voodolls community!

We're thrilled to announce the release of a new patch for Voodolls, bringing several exciting improvements and fixes to enhance your cooperative Action Tower Defense experience. This update addresses various issues reported by our dedicated players, ensuring smoother gameplay and increased immersion in the spherical worlds of redemption and demon-chasing. Let's dive into the details of what this patch has in store for you:

Patch Highlights:

[list]
[*] Iselin trail now correctly completes after eliminating all cursed Whenu individuals on the Death's Garden level.
[*] Background functionality is deactivated when players select the Help option, allowing for better focus on the game.
[*] The Trap Loadout menu can now be scrolled at all times, making it easier to manage your resources.
[*] The Meta Resource tutorial pop-up will now be displayed whenever players collect a collectible for the first time, providing valuable guidance.
[*] Fonts in the traps option menu have been adjusted to ensure consistency and visual appeal.
[*] The Chest no longer penetrates via Puppet after players change their camera view, resolving a visual inconsistency.
[*] The Whenu helper achievement now unlocks properly, recognizing your accomplishments.
[*] Enemies now spawn correctly during the Enchanted Forest trail, increasing the challenge and excitement.
[*] Enemies will now spawn near Wineo even when players haven't accepted the Iselin trail, maintaining a balanced gameplay experience.
[*] The Skullbringer image now accurately represents its model, ensuring visual fidelity.
[*] Lobby settings have been adjusted for a more streamlined multiplayer experience.
[*] The Red Path is now correctly displayed on surfaces during Build mode, allowing for better planning and strategy.
[/list]
We hope these updates enhance your Voodolls journey and provide a smoother gameplay experience. As always, we appreciate your invaluable feedback and support. Stay tuned for more exciting content and updates coming your way!

Keep defending, keep cooperating, and let the adventure unfold!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 for Voodolls
notes.content:
Hello Voodolls community,

We're thrilled to announce the release of a new patch for Voodolls, packed with various fixes and improvements to enhance your cooperative experience! Let's dive into the details:

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] We've adjusted the sound effects for weapons and objects, ensuring a more immersive gameplay audio.
[*] A visual inconsistency related to the Spiritual Strike (Ability 3) cooldown for clients has been resolved, providing a smoother visual experience.
[*] We've addressed an issue where clients' abilities would become jammed in multiplayer sessions, ensuring they are always usable as intended.
[*] The host player's movement animation no longer gets jammed, resulting in more fluid gameplay.
[*] The Greater Demon will no longer stand idle when a player places the Luring Ritual trap in front of it, ensuring a more challenging and engaging encounter.
[*] The enemy will now properly maintain the Stunned state when a player performs Lunacy's ability Death Wish, ensuring a more balanced gameplay experience.
[*] Clients will always be able to collect collectibles, resolving an issue where certain players were unable to do so.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] We've made an improvement to the hit marker scale, which now depends on the crosshair scale. This will provide better visual feedback for successful hits.
[*] Interactable buildings will no longer be affected by status effects such as stun or slow, resulting in a more consistent gameplay experience.
[*] We've updated the color of People's Health bars to green, making it easier to distinguish their health status.
[/list]

We hope that these fixes and improvements will enhance your overall gameplay experience in Voodolls. Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. As always, feel free to reach out to us with any further suggestions or bug reports.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Voodolls 1.0.1 Patch Available
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of a new patch for Voodolls! This update brings a range of improvements and fixes that will enhance your gaming experience. Let's dive into the key highlights:

[list]
[*] [b]Ferthur Avatar Active:[/b] Ferthur Avatar will no longer remain idle when a puppet is in close proximity, ensuring increased engagement and strategic gameplay.
[*] [b]Iselin Trial Enhancements:[/b] Pop-up notifications during Iselin Trial will no longer overlap with the Minimap, allowing for a more seamless and immersive experience.
[*] [b]Marid's Continuous Action:[/b] Marid, the relentless foe, will now consistently engage players instead of standing idle, intensifying the challenge and keeping you on your toes.
[*] [b]Souls Persistence:[/b] Players will rejoice as souls no longer reset to 0 when they successfully eliminate enemies on the 3rd floor of the Ferthur's Kingdom level. Your hard-earned progress will remain intact!
[*] [b]Smooth Animation:[/b] The heavy pocketed animation issue that occurred during Multiplayer matches has been addressed and resolved. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with flawless animations.
[*] [b]Interactive Tutorial Experience:[/b] The Esc button now functions seamlessly during the Tutorial, providing full interactivity and allowing you to navigate and explore the game's mechanics effortlessly.
[/list]
We believe that these improvements will significantly enhance your gameplay and provide a smoother, more immersive experience in the fantastical world of Voodolls. Stay tuned for further updates as we continue to refine and enhance the game based on your feedback!

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the latest patch. See you in the spherical worlds of Voodolls!

The Voodolls Development Team

notes.title: Voodolls Beta Update - Fixes
notes.content:
With the open beta in full swing, we want to address some of the issues that have been brought up by the community. With this in mind, we've push through a small patch to directly address a number of issues. The following is the lists of fixes this update addresses - 

-Owner of a trap is shown for clients when they target it

-Player can now take damage after from Greater Demon when he misses Stun attack

-Fixed taunt on Asakku

-Save skin selection

-Fixed star compute on end of a level

-Respawn bar fixed on client side

-Infinite loading screen fixed

-General connection stability

-News feed is fixed

- A message box appear on the main menu to help the players when them run into a issues (‘’Host is disconnected’’, ‘’You are not connect to internet’’, ‘’The room XXXXX doesn’t exist’’)


Thank you for your time and we hope you are enjoying what the Beta has to offer!
